notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!

Nice to meet you all.

Today we are announcing an event to celebrate Halloween!

After accessing the game, enter "Z.I.P.P.Y" in the correct order on the title screen. :)

So, have a happy Halloween everyone, and we will prepare an even more awesome event next time.

Thank you!

notes.title: Introducing a new mode for Primal Slideee!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This time, I would like to tell you about a new update :)

After much trial and error, “Survival Mode” was released.

If you download the new game file, you can enjoy the new mode “Survival.”

It is not boring, as it uses a different play style than before and requires a lot of concentration and tension.

Since it has just been released, you can set a world record if you try it right now!

Survival mode will be available to play in approximately 2 to 3 days!
